UNFPA Report: Over a Quarter of India's Population is Youth

A report by the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) indicates that individuals aged 10 to 24 years constitute more than one-fourth of India's total population. The report highlights the significant demographic presence of this youth segment within the country.
